from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import combinations
def count(segs,eps=F(3)):
    def inter(s,t):
        (x1,y1),(x2,y2)=s;(x3,y3),(x4,y4)=t
        d=(x1-x2)*(y3-y4)-(y1-y2)*(x3-x4)
        if d==0: return None
        px=F((x1*y2-y1*x2)*(x3-x4)-(x1-x2)*(x3*y4-y3*x4),d)
        py=F((x1*y2-y1*x2)*(y3-y4)-(y1-y2)*(x3*y4-y3*x4),d)
        def on(s):
            (a,b),(c,e)=s
            return min(a,c)-eps<=px<=max(a,c)+eps and min(b,e)-eps<=py<=max(b,e)+eps
        return (px,py) if on(s) and on(t) else None
    n=0
    for a,b,c in combinations(segs,3):
        p,q,r=inter(a,b),inter(b,c),inter(a,c)
        if None in (p,q,r): continue
        if abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1])<2 or abs(p[0]-r[0])+abs(p[1]-r[1])<2 or abs(q[0]-r[0])+abs(q[1]-r[1])<2: continue
        n+=1
    return n
